testsuite.name: com.geoknoesis.trustweave.saas.server.oid4vp.VerificationRequestServiceTest

testcase.name: an expired request cannot be satisfied()
each request gets its own unguessable nonce()
the QR payload carries the client id and a request uri()
requested claims survive being stored and read back()
history is bounded and rejects excessive page sizes()
history cleanup removes expired personal data using the database batch query()
the request object asks for the requested type and echoes the nonce()
blank and duplicate claim names are cleaned up rather than sent to the wallet()
the credential type is still constrained when claims are named()
a claim is looked for wherever the format puts it()
a completed session refuses a second presentation()
an unknown session id yields nothing()
a presentation without holder binding is rejected()
a request naming no claims does not limit disclosure()
cancellation is tenant bound and prevents subsequent submission()
a request naming claims asks for those claims and limits disclosure to them()
reads expire unanswered requests()
the request is addressed to this verifier()
an unparseable presentation is rejected, not accepted()
concurrent submissions cannot overwrite a terminal result()
an empty request asks for any trusted credential rather than matching nothing()
